title: Veloscuro - The Shape of Dust
description:
"The Shape of Dust" is a visual companion to the debut album by Veloscuro, a beautiful journey of distance and the beauty found in forgotten places.

The album "The Shape of Dust" is out now on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and all major streaming platforms - https://artists.landr.com/991048428164

Thank you for watching, listening and stepping into this world. It means everything to me.
